result.topic_en: A page in English, dated 1794 and signed J.F.E. Gauss, giving drawings of eight knots (thumb knot, loop knot, draw knot, ring knot, running knot and others) with a note on how one knot closes or opens depending on which ends are pulled.
result.transcription:
Gauß, Math. 33 \quad 48/3
167 \quad 216 . 2. \quad (3)
J.F.E. Gauss . 1794
A collection of knots.
1. thumb knot \quad [-of-] which taylors make use of
2. loop. knot
3 draw knot
4 ring knot
5/
6 running knot
7/
8/ \quad a \quad b \quad c \quad d
Drawn at a, b it will close.
but drawn at c, d it will open again.
[-36.-]

items.quote:
Drawn at a, b it will close.
but drawn at c, d it will open again.
items.english: Pulled at ends a and b it will close, but pulled at ends c and d it will open again.
